cards.text:
DZ-SS06/001EN
Grand March of Full Bloom, Lianorn
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC)[1/Turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1], draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and call it to (RC) or discard it.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Soul-Blast 1] & discard a card from hand], and boost this unit with all of your back row [Stand] units with "Boost". If you boosted this unit with three or more units, this unit gets drive +1 until end of that battle, and at the end of that battle, choose two of your back row rear-guards, and [Stand] them.

DZ-SS06/002EN
Brilliant Tune, Rektina
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by a unit with "Lianorn" in its card name, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose a grade 1 or less card from your drop, and call it to (RC).
[CONT](RC):If your back row has three or more rear-guards, this unit gets "Boost".

DZ-SS06/003EN
Budding of Pleasant Sounds, Gracia
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Brilliant Tune, Rektina", you may call this card to (RC).
[CONT](RC):During the battle this unit boosted a vanguard, this unit gets [Power]+5000.

DZ-SS06/004EN
Announcing Wind of Spring, Corphie
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

DZ-SS06/005EN
Marche Fleur, Lianorn Vivace
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
UnisonDress - [AUTO]:When this unit is placed by riding from a unit in the UnisonDress state or a unit with "Lianorn" in its different card name from this unit, draw a card, and this unit is in the UnisonDress state until end of this fight.
[AUTO](VC)[1/Turn]:When this unit in the UnisonDress state attacks while not boosted, [Stand] all of your rear-guards, and boost this unit with them. If you boosted with three or more units, at the end of that battle, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose three of your units, [Stand] them, and they get [Power]+5000/drive -1 until end of turn. (Rear-guards without "Boost" can boost too)

DZ-SS06/006EN
Resonance Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](RC):If your units boosted a total of three or more times this turn, this unit gets [Power]+5000.
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked a vanguard, if you have a vanguard with "Lianorn" in its card name, and your units boosted a total of five or more times this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1] & put this unit into soul], choose one of your rear-guards, and [Stand] it.

DZ-SS06/007EN
Friendly Broccolly
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, if you have a token unit on your (RC), [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and draw a card.
[CONT](RC)/(GC):If you have a token unit on your (RC), this unit gets [Power]+5000/[Shield]+5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)

DZ-SS06/008EN
Ethereal Cadence, Lagrace
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), choose a grade 3 card with "Lianorn" in its card name from your ride deck, and you may reveal it. If you revealed a card, or you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Lianorn" in its card name, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one card with "Lianorn" in its card name from among them, reveal it and put it into hand, and shuffle the deck. If you did not put a card into hand, draw a card.
[CONT](RC)/(GC):If your back row has two or more grade 1 or less rear-guards, this unit gets "Boost" and [Power]+5000/[Shield]+5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)

DZ-SS06/009EN
Luster Impact Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if your back row has two or more grade 1 or less rear-guards, this unit gets "Boost", and [Power]+5000. [AUTO](RC)[1/Turn]:When this unit [Stand] by the ability of your vanguard with "Granfia" or "Lianorn" in its card name, if your vanguard's [Power] is 33000 or greater, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], draw a card, and this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.

DZ-SS06/010EN
Rhythm of Joy, Elentis
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have a vanguard with "Lianorn" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+2000. If your vanguard is in the UnisonDress state, it gets [Power]+5000 instead of +2000.
[AUTO](RC):At the end of your turn, if your vanguard was boosted a total of three or more times this turn, [COST][retire this unit], draw a card, and if your damage zone has no face up cards, [Counter-Charge 1].

DZ-SS06/011EN
Concert of Many Emotions, Parsea
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) other than during the battle phase, choose up to one card with the UnisonDress ability from your hand, and reveal it. If you revealed a card, or your vanguard is in the UnisonDress state, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose a card from your drop with a different card name from this unit and grade less than or equal to your vanguard, and call it to (RC).
[AUTO](RC):At the beginning of your main phase, if your vanguard is in the UnisonDress state, you may put this unit into soul.

DZ-SS06/012EN
Rosarium Fairy
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][retire another rear-guard], and call up to two Plant tokens to (RC). (Plant tokens are grade 0/[Power]5000/[Critical]1 and have boost)
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if you have a vanguard with "Granfia" or "Lianorn" in its card name, and your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, choose one of your other back row rear-guards, and increase this unit's [Power] by that unit's [Power] until end of that battle.

DZ-SS06/013EN
Custodial Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 1｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. If your hand has two or more cards, choose a card from your hand, and discard it.

DZ-SS06/014EN
Source Dragon Deity of Blessings, Blessfavor
Trigger Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Draw a card! Choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical]+1 until end of turn! All of your front row units get [Power]+10000! If your damage zone has the same number of cards as your opponent's or more, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!

DZ-SS06/015EN
Melodia Pomera
Trigger Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical]+1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

DZ-SS06/016EN
Cymbal Hamster
Trigger Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

DZ-SS06/017EN
Prominent Elf
Trigger Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power]+10000 until end of turn!)

DZ-SS06/018EN
Flowery Tone
Trigger Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

DZ-SS06/019EN
Sound of Wave
Blitz Order｜ -｜ Grade 2｜ Power -｜ Shield -
Regalis Piece (You may only have one Regalis Piece in your deck, and use it a total of one time in a fight)
If your vanguard's grade is less than your opponent's vanguard's grade, this ability can be played while ignoring grade.
Choose a unit being attacked, and it gets [Power]+15000 until end of that battle. Choose one of your opponent's units, until end of turn, it gets [Power]-5000, and if your opponent persona rode this turn, it gets [Power]-10000 instead of -5000.

DZ-SS06/020EN
Elementaria Sanctitude
Blitz Order｜ ｜ Grade 1｜ Power -｜ Shield -
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[CONT]:You may only have one "Elementaria Sanctitude" in a deck.
If your opponent's vanguard has "Triple Drive", this ability can be played without paying the cost.
Play this with [COST][discard a card from hand] if your vanguard is grade 3 or less!
Choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. Remove this card.

DZ-SS06/T01EN
Plant
Others｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield -
(This represents a Plant token, and cannot be put in a deck)

DZ-SS08/015EN
Soaring Sun Presence, Forwd&Revertis
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand other than during the battle phase, [Soul-Charge 1], and this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn. [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and perform one of the following.
・Choose one of your opponent's grade 2 or greater rear-guards, and retire it.
・Choose a grade 2 or less card from your soul, and call it to (RC).

DZ-SS08/016EN
Dark Bond Abyss, Surga&Dargage
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜Brandt Gate｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand other than during the battle phase, look at the same number of cards from the top of your deck as the number of set orders in your order zone +1, choose a card from among them, put it into soul, and if you looked at two or more cards, shuffle the deck. [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and perform one of the following.
・Choose a grade 2 or greater unit card from your soul, and put it into hand.
・Choose a set order from your soul, and put it into hand.

DZ-SS08/017EN
Gallant Mechanical Agility, Valtrossa&Liel
Normal Unit｜ Brandt Gate｜Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand other than during the battle phase, choose up to one normal unit without sentinel or up to one order card from your drop, and put it on the bottom of the deck. [COST][Counter-Blast 1], look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to one card from among them, reveal it, and perform one of the following.
・If the revealed card is an order card without Regalis Piece, put it into hand. Shuffle the deck.
・If the revealed card's grade is less than or equal to the vanguard's grade, call it to (RC). Shuffle the deck.

DZ-SS08/018EN
Azure Sky White Scale, Aspronia&Sapphira
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜Stoicheia｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand other than during the battle phase, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of the deck or discard it. [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and perform one of the following.
・Choose a normal order from your drop, and put it into hand.
・Choose a grade 2 or greater card from your drop, and call it to (RC).

DZ-SS08/019EN
Flame Leaf Chaotic Dance, Hakusui&Remred
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand other than during the battle phase, you may call a Plant token to (RC). [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and perform one of the following.
・You get "All of your rear-guards that were placed by your card's ability this turn get [Power]+5000." until end of turn.
・Choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn. If you have four or more units, it gets [Power]+10000 instead of +5000.

DZ-SS08/Re42EN
Go Ahead, Mikani
Normal Unit｜ Brandt Gate｜Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), you may [Soul-Charge 1].
[ACT](RC):If your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][put this unit into soul], choose up to one grade 3 card with "Mikani" in its card name from your soul, and call it to (RC).
[Glitter] - Kheios (Active if your vanguard is a [Glitter] with "Kheios" in its card name)
[CONT](Soul):When you would count the number of different card names in your soul for your card's ability, all "Go Ahead, Mikani" in your soul each count as a different card name.

DZ-SS08/Re47EN
Atrocious? Moth Girl, Maple
Normal Unit｜ Stoicheia｜Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](Drop):When your grade 3 or greater vanguard is placed during the ride phase, if you do not have a unit with "Maple" in its card name, you may call this card to (RC). (If there are 2 copies of this card in drop, you can only call one)
[Glitter] - Thegrea (Active if your vanguard is a [Glitter] with "Thegrea" in its card name)
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked, [COST][Soul-Blast 1] or more cards], choose a card from your soul with the same grade as the sum of the grades of the cards [Soul-Blast] for this cost, put it into hand, and put this unit into soul.
